notes: formvfx's text animation presets (Apache-2.0). Key times are seconds from the time the preset is applied; selector paths are relative to the selector.

presets.name: Bounce In Characters
presets.description: Characters scale up with an overshoot.

presets.name: Bounce In Lines
presets.description: Lines scale up with an overshoot, one after another.

presets.name: Center Spread
presets.description: Characters spread out from the middle while fading in.

presets.name: Drop In Characters
presets.description: Each character drops from above.

presets.name: Drop In Words
presets.description: Each word drops from above.

presets.name: Fade Down Characters
presets.description: Each character fades in while settling down into place.

presets.name: Fade Down Lines
presets.description: Each line fades in while settling down into place.

presets.name: Fade Down Words
presets.description: Each word fades in while settling down into place.

presets.name: Fade In Characters
presets.description: Each character fades in, in reading order.

presets.name: Fade In Lines
presets.description: Each line fades in, in reading order.

presets.name: Fade In Words
presets.description: Each word fades in, in reading order.

presets.name: Fade Up Characters
presets.description: Each character fades in while rising into place.

presets.name: Fade Up Lines
presets.description: Each line fades in while rising into place.

presets.name: Fade Up Words
presets.description: Each word fades in while rising into place.

presets.name: Pop In Words
presets.description: Words pop to full size with a quick overshoot.

presets.name: Raining Characters In
presets.description: Characters fall from far above in random order and land in place.

presets.name: Random Drop In
presets.description: Characters drop from above in random order.

presets.name: Random Fade In
presets.description: Characters fade in in random order.

presets.name: Random Scale In
presets.description: Characters pop up from nothing in random order.

presets.name: Rise In Characters
presets.description: Each character rises from below.

presets.name: Rise In Words
presets.description: Each word rises from below.

presets.name: Scale Down Characters
presets.description: Each character shrinks into place from three times its size.

presets.name: Scale Down Words
presets.description: Each word shrinks into place from three times its size.

presets.name: Scale Up Characters
presets.description: Each character grows from nothing.

presets.name: Scale Up Lines
presets.description: Each line grows from nothing.

presets.name: Scale Up Words
presets.description: Each word grows from nothing.

presets.name: Skew In Characters
presets.description: Each character straightens from a slant while fading in.

presets.name: Skew In Words
presets.description: Each word straightens from a slant while fading in.

presets.name: Slam In Words
presets.description: Words slam down from huge and blurred.

presets.name: Slide In Left Characters
presets.description: Each character slides in from the left while fading in.

presets.name: Slide In Left Lines
presets.description: Each line slides in from the left while fading in.

presets.name: Slide In Left Words
presets.description: Each word slides in from the left while fading in.

presets.name: Slide In Right Characters
presets.description: Each character slides in from the right while fading in.

presets.name: Slide In Right Lines
presets.description: Each line slides in from the right while fading in.

presets.name: Slide In Right Words
presets.description: Each word slides in from the right while fading in.

presets.name: Spin In Characters
presets.description: Each character spins half a turn into place while growing.

presets.name: Spin In Words
presets.description: Each word spins half a turn into place while growing.

presets.name: Stretch In Horizontal Characters
presets.description: Each character unfolds from a vertical sliver.

presets.name: Stretch In Horizontal Words
presets.description: Each word unfolds from a vertical sliver.

presets.name: Stretch In Vertical Characters
presets.description: Each character unfolds from a horizontal sliver.

presets.name: Stretch In Vertical Lines
presets.description: Each line unfolds from a horizontal sliver.

presets.name: Stretch In Vertical Words
presets.description: Each word unfolds from a horizontal sliver.

presets.name: Swing In Characters
presets.description: Each character swings down from its top edge.

presets.name: Swing In Words
presets.description: Each word swings down from its top edge.

presets.name: Typewriter Characters
presets.description: Each character appears at once, hard-edged, in reading order.

presets.name: Typewriter Lines
presets.description: Each line appears at once, hard-edged, in reading order.

presets.name: Typewriter Words
presets.description: Each word appears at once, hard-edged, in reading order.

presets.name: Wipe In
presets.description: The text wipes on from left to right with a soft edge.

presets.name: Blow Up Out Characters
presets.description: Each character grows huge and fades away.

presets.name: Blow Up Out Words
presets.description: Each word grows huge and fades away.

presets.name: Blur Out Characters
presets.description: Each character blurs and fades away.

presets.name: Blur Out Lines
presets.description: Each line blurs and fades away.

presets.name: Blur Out Words
presets.description: Each word blurs and fades away.

presets.name: Collapse Out
presets.description: Characters squeeze together and vanish.

presets.name: Drop Out
presets.description: Characters fall away in random order.

presets.name: Explode Out
presets.description: Characters scatter outward and fade, in random order.

presets.name: Fade Out Characters
presets.description: Each character fades out, in reading order.

presets.name: Fade Out Down Characters
presets.description: Each character fades out while sinking.

presets.name: Fade Out Down Lines
presets.description: Each line fades out while sinking.

presets.name: Fade Out Down Words
presets.description: Each word fades out while sinking.

presets.name: Fade Out Lines
presets.description: Each line fades out, in reading order.

presets.name: Fade Out Up Characters
presets.description: Each character fades out while rising.

presets.name: Fade Out Up Lines
presets.description: Each line fades out while rising.

presets.name: Fade Out Up Words
presets.description: Each word fades out while rising.

presets.name: Fade Out Words
presets.description: Each word fades out, in reading order.

presets.name: Random Fade Out
presets.description: Characters fade out in random order.

presets.name: Scale Out Characters
presets.description: Each character shrinks to nothing.

presets.name: Scale Out Lines
presets.description: Each line shrinks to nothing.

presets.name: Scale Out Words
presets.description: Each word shrinks to nothing.

presets.name: Slide Out Left Characters
presets.description: Each character slides away to the left while fading out.

presets.name: Slide Out Left Words
presets.description: Each word slides away to the left while fading out.

presets.name: Slide Out Right Characters
presets.description: Each character slides away to the right while fading out.

presets.name: Slide Out Right Words
presets.description: Each word slides away to the right while fading out.

presets.name: Spin Out Characters
presets.description: Each character spins away while shrinking.

presets.name: Spin Out Words
presets.description: Each word spins away while shrinking.

presets.name: Tracking Out
presets.description: Spacing widens while the text fades out.

presets.name: Typewriter Erase Characters
presets.description: Each character disappears at once, hard-edged, in reading order.

presets.name: Typewriter Erase Words
presets.description: Each word disappears at once, hard-edged, in reading order.

presets.name: Blur In Characters
presets.description: Each character comes into focus and fades in.

presets.name: Blur In Lines
presets.description: Each line comes into focus and fades in.

presets.name: Blur In Words
presets.description: Each word comes into focus and fades in.

presets.name: Blur Out Random
presets.description: Characters blur away in random order.

presets.name: Blur Through
presets.description: A soft blur passes through the text from left to right.

presets.name: Blur Wave Loop
presets.description: A blur band sweeps across the text again and again.

presets.name: Focus Pull
presets.description: The whole line racks from blurred to sharp.

presets.name: Horizontal Blur In
presets.description: Characters streak in from a horizontal blur.

presets.name: Soft Focus Drift
presets.description: Characters drift in and out of focus at random.

presets.name: Vertical Blur In
presets.description: Characters drop in from a vertical blur.

presets.name: Color Flash Random
presets.description: Characters flash white at random.

presets.name: Darken In
presets.description: Characters rise out of darkness.

presets.name: Desaturate In
presets.description: Characters gain their colour in reading order.

presets.name: Fill Color Change
presets.description: The fill changes to orange in reading order.

presets.name: Fill Color Wave
presets.description: An orange band passes through the characters.

presets.name: Fill Fade In
presets.description: The fill fades in after the text appears, in reading order.

presets.name: Highlight Sweep
presets.description: A bright band sweeps across the text.

presets.name: Highlight Sweep Loop
presets.description: A bright band sweeps across the text again and again.

presets.name: Hue Cycle
presets.description: The fill colour cycles through the spectrum, continuously.

presets.name: Hue Wave
presets.description: A rainbow travels along the characters.

presets.name: Stroke Grow
presets.description: An orange outline thickens in reading order.

presets.name: Stroke Pulse
presets.description: An orange outline pulses in width, continuously.

presets.name: Fade From White
presets.description: The text fades in from white.

presets.name: Flash In
presets.description: Characters appear white-hot and cool to their colour.

presets.name: Glow Pass
presets.description: A soft glowing band of light passes over the text.

presets.name: Light Speed In
presets.description: Characters streak in from the left like light.

presets.name: Shimmer
presets.description: Characters glint at random, continuously.

presets.name: Strobe
presets.description: Characters blink on and off at random.

presets.name: Counter Up
presets.description: Digits roll upward before settling.

presets.name: Decoder
presets.description: Characters appear as random symbols, then resolve in reading order.

presets.name: Glitch
presets.description: Characters jump, slant and break apart at random, continuously.

presets.name: Glitch In
presets.description: Characters glitch into place.

presets.name: Robot Steps
presets.description: Characters snap into place in hard steps.

presets.name: Scramble In
presets.description: Letters cycle through random characters before settling, left to right.

presets.name: Shutter In
presets.description: Lines open like shutters, one after another.

presets.name: Slot Machine
presets.description: Characters spin through letters and stop in reading order.

presets.name: Drop In Lines
presets.description: Lines drop from above with a slight rotation, one after another.

presets.name: Lines Blur In Stagger
presets.description: Lines come into focus one after another.

presets.name: Lines Close Up
presets.description: Lines move together from far apart.

presets.name: Lines Fade Out Up
presets.description: Lines fade out upward, one after another.

presets.name: Lines Scale Pop
presets.description: Lines pop up one after another.

presets.name: Lines Slide Alternate
presets.description: Lines slide in from alternating sides.

presets.name: Lines Typewriter
presets.description: Lines appear one at a time, hard-edged.

presets.name: Lines Wipe Up
presets.description: Lines grow up from their baselines, one after another.

presets.name: Breathing
presets.description: The text slowly swells and relaxes, continuously.

presets.name: Bubble Up
presets.description: Characters bubble up from below in random order.

presets.name: Dance
presets.description: Characters hop and sway, continuously.

expressions.amount: var s = Math.abs(Math.sin(time * 5 + textIndex * 1.3)) * 100; [s, s, s]

presets.name: Float
presets.description: Characters drift gently, continuously.

presets.name: Jelly Wobble
presets.description: Characters squash and stretch like jelly, continuously.

expressions.amount: var s = Math.sin(time * 6 - textIndex * 0.7) * 100; [s, s, s]

presets.name: Jitter
presets.description: Characters wobble randomly in position and rotation, continuously.

presets.name: Ripple
presets.description: A ripple rolls along the characters, continuously.

presets.name: Wave
presets.description: Characters ride a wave, continuously.

expressions.amount: var s = Math.sin(time * 4 - textIndex * 0.5) * 100; [s, s, s]

presets.name: Wind Blown
presets.description: Characters blow away to the right in random order.

presets.name: Pendulum Words
presets.description: Words sway like pendulums from their tops.

presets.name: Rotate Through
presets.description: A twist travels through the characters.

presets.name: Spin Continuous
presets.description: Every character spins in place without stopping.

presets.name: Tilt Wave
presets.description: A rocking wave rolls along the characters.

expressions.amount: var s = Math.sin(time * 4 - textIndex * 0.6) * 100; [s, s, s]

presets.name: Tumble In
presets.description: Characters tumble a full turn into place in random order.

presets.name: Twirl Out
presets.description: Characters twirl away upward in random order.

presets.name: Wobble
presets.description: Characters wobble back and forth, continuously.

presets.name: Grow Wave Loop
presets.description: A swell rolls along the text again and again.

presets.name: Heartbeat
presets.description: The text beats like a heart.

presets.name: Pulse
presets.description: Characters swell and shrink at random, continuously.

presets.name: Scale Bounce Loop
presets.description: Characters bounce their scale in a travelling wave.

expressions.amount: var s = Math.abs(Math.sin(time * 3 - textIndex * 0.5)) * 100; [s, s, s]

presets.name: Shrink Words
presets.description: Words shrink away one after another.

presets.name: Squash and Stretch In
presets.description: Characters land squashed and spring back.

presets.name: Zoom Through
presets.description: A swell travels through the characters.

presets.name: Breathe
presets.description: Spacing swells and relaxes, continuously.

presets.name: Collapse
presets.description: Spacing tightens until characters touch.

presets.name: Expand
presets.description: Spacing slowly widens over the whole duration.

presets.name: Line Spacing Open
presets.description: Lines spread apart from on top of each other.

presets.name: Tracking In Tight
presets.description: Overlapping characters open up to normal spacing.

presets.name: Tracking In Wide
presets.description: Very wide spacing tightens while the text fades in.

presets.name: 3D Wave
presets.description: A wave of rotation rolls along the characters in depth, continuously.

expressions.amount: var s = Math.sin(time * 3 - textIndex * 0.5) * 100; [s, s, s]

presets.name: Cascade 3D
presets.description: Characters tumble down in depth, one after another.

presets.name: Depth Fade In
presets.description: Characters fade in while rising out of depth.

presets.name: Flip In X
presets.description: Characters flip down into place around their horizontal axis.

presets.name: Flip In Y
presets.description: Characters turn into place around their vertical axis.

presets.name: Fly In From Behind
presets.description: Characters fly forward from deep behind the layer.

presets.name: Fly Out Toward Camera
presets.description: Characters fly toward the viewer and vanish.

presets.name: Orbit Characters
presets.description: Characters orbit gently around their centres, continuously.

presets.name: Random Tumble 3D
presets.description: Characters tumble into place in depth, in random order.

presets.name: Spin Y Continuous
presets.description: Every character spins around its vertical axis, continuously.

presets.name: Swing Down 3D
presets.description: Characters swing down from their tops, in depth.

presets.name: Unfold Lines 3D
presets.description: Lines unfold toward the viewer, one after another.

presets.name: Hop
presets.description: Characters hop once in reading order.

presets.name: Jumble
presets.description: Characters sit at random offsets and slowly settle.

presets.name: Lean Back
presets.description: Words lean back and straighten one after another.

presets.name: Shake
presets.description: The whole line shakes hard, continuously.

presets.name: Sink In
presets.description: Characters sink into the baseline in reading order.

presets.name: Spread Words
presets.description: Words spread apart from the middle.

expressions.amount: var c = (textTotal - 1) / 2; var s = (textIndex - 1 - c) * 100 / Math.max(1, c); [s, s, s]
